```text
    return parent;
}
inline bool MotionSystem::reparentLayer(LayerId id, LayerId parent) {
    const auto current = getLayer(id);
    if (!current || !current->parent || !getLayer(parent)) return false;
    if (current->parent == parent) return true;
    auto ancestor = std::optional<LayerId>(parent);
    while (ancestor) {
        if (*ancestor == id) return false;
        ancestor = layers_.at(*ancestor).parent;
    }
    auto staged = layers_;
    auto& old = staged.at(*current->parent).children;
    old.erase(std::find(old.begin(), old.end(), id));
    staged.at(parent).children.push_back(id);
    staged.at(id).parent = parent;
    layers_.swap(staged);
    return true;
}
inline bool MotionSystem::setLayer(LayerId id, const LayerConfig& config) {
    const auto found = layers_.find(id);
    if (found == layers_.end() || !validLayer(config)) return false;
    found->second.config = config;
    return true;
}
inline bool MotionSystem::bindMotion(LayerId layer, std::optional<MotionId> motion) {
    const auto current = getLayer(layer);
    if (!current || (motion && !getMotion(*motion))) return false;
    auto config = current->config;
    config.motion = motion;
    return setLayer(layer, config);
}
inline std::optional<MotionSample> MotionSystem::layerMatrices(LayerId leaf) const {
    std::vector<LayerId> chain;
    auto current = std::optional<LayerId>(leaf);
    while (current) {
        const auto layer = getLayer(*current);
        if (!layer || chain.size() >= layers_.size()) return {};
        chain.push_back(*current);
        current = layer->parent;
    }
    MotionSample result;
    for (auto i = chain.rbegin(); i != chain.rend(); ++i) {
        const auto& config = layers_.at(*i).config;
        if (!config.enabled) continue;
        MotionSample own;
        if (config.space == TransformSpace::World) own.parent = config.transform;
        else own.local = config.transform;
        if (config.motion) {
            const auto state = getMotion(*config.motion);
            if (!state) return {};
            if (state->enabled) {
                own.parent = state->sampled.parent * own.parent;
                own.local = state->sampled.local * own.local;
            }
        }
        if (*i == rootLayer()) result.parent = own.parent * own.local;
        else {
            result.parent *= own.parent;
            result.local *= own.local;
        }
        if (!TransformSystem::validAffine(result.parent)
            || !TransformSystem::validAffine(result.local)) return {};
    }
    return result;
}
inline std::optional<MotionId> MotionSystem::createSpin(RotationMotion config) {
    config.space = TransformSpace::Local;

    if (!motion.append(Motion::rotation(config))) return {};
    return createMotion(motion);
}
inline std::optional<MotionId> MotionSystem::createOrbit(RotationMotion config) {
    config.space = TransformSpace::World;
    Motion motion;
    if (!motion.append(Motion::rotation(config))) return {};
    return createMotion(motion);
}
inline std::optional<MotionId> MotionSystem::createOrbitAndSpin(RotationMotion orbit,
                                                            RotationMotion spin) {
    orbit.space = TransformSpace::World;
    spin.space = TransformSpace::Local;
    Motion motion;
    if (!motion.append(Motion::rotation(orbit)) || !motion.append(Motion::rotation(spin))) return {};
    return createMotion(motion);
}
inline std::optional<MotionId> MotionSystem::createPathAndSpin(const PathMotion& path,
                                                           RotationMotion spin) {
    spin.space = TransformSpace::Local;
    Motion motion;
    if (!motion.append(Motion::followPath(path)) || !motion.append(Motion::rotation(spin))) return {};
    return createMotion(motion);
}
```

```text
inline MotionStep Motion::followPath(const PathMotion& config) {
    MotionStep step;
    if (!config.path || !config.interpolation || !std::isfinite(config.durationSeconds)
        || config.durationSeconds <= 0 || !std::isfinite(config.rate) || config.rate == 0
        || !std::isfinite(config.phase) || config.phase < 0 || config.phase > 1) return step;
    step.space = config.space;
    if (config.playback == Playback::Once) {
        step.durationSeconds = (config.rate > 0 ? 1 - config.phase : config.phase)
                             * config.durationSeconds / std::abs(config.rate);
        if (!std::isfinite(*step.durationSeconds)) return MotionStep{};
    }
    step.transform = [config](double seconds) {
        double progress = config.phase + seconds / config.durationSeconds * config.rate;
        if (!std::isfinite(progress)) throw std::domain_error("Path time overflow.");
        if (config.playback == Playback::Once) progress = std::clamp(progress, 0.0, 1.0);
        else if (config.playback == Playback::Loop) progress -= std::floor(progress);
        else {
            progress -= std::floor(progress / 2) * 2;
            if (progress > 1) progress = 2 - progress;
        }
        const double u = config.interpolation(progress);
        if (!std::isfinite(u)) throw std::domain_error("Interpolation returned non-finite progress.");

        if (config.relativeToStart) {
            const double initial = config.interpolation(config.phase);
            if (!std::isfinite(initial)) throw std::domain_error("Invalid initial interpolation.");
            offset -= config.path(initial);
        }
        const auto matrix = TransformSystem::translation(offset);
        if (!matrix) throw std::domain_error("Path returned a non-finite position.");
        return *matrix;
    };
    return step;

inline bool MotionSystem::update(double deltaSeconds) {

    std::vector<Pending> pending;
    pending.reserve(motions_.size());
    for (const auto& entry : motions_) {
        const auto& state = entry.second;

        const double time = state.timeSeconds + deltaSeconds;
        const auto sample = state.motion.sample(time);
        if (!sample) return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Motion, "MotionSystem::update", "Rejected condition: !sample", "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships.");

inline std::optional<LayerId> MotionSystem::insertLayer(LayerId child, const LayerConfig& config) {

inline std::optional<MotionSample> MotionSystem::layerMatrices(LayerId leaf) const {
    std::vector<LayerId> chain;

    while (current) {

        if (!layer || chain.size() >= layers_.size()) return (Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Motion, "MotionSystem::layerMatrices", "Rejected condition: !layer || chain.size() >= layers_.size()", "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships."), std::nullopt);

        current = layer->parent;
    }
    MotionSample result;
    for (auto i = chain.rbegin(); i != chain.rend(); ++i) {
        const auto& config = layers_.at(*i).config;
        if (!config.enabled) continue;
        MotionSample own;
        if (config.space == TransformSpace::World) own.parent = config.transform;
        else own.local = config.transform;
        if (config.motion) {
            const auto state = getMotion(*config.motion);
            if (!state) return (Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Motion, "MotionSystem::layerMatrices", "Rejected condition: !state", "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships."), std::nullopt);

                own.local = state->sampled.local * own.local;

        else {
            result.parent *= own.parent;
            result.local *= own.local;

        if (!TransformSystem::validAffine(result.parent)
            || !TransformSystem::validAffine(result.local)) return (Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Motion, "MotionSystem::layerMatrices", "Rejected condition: !TransformSystem::validAffine(result.parent) || !TransformSystem::validAffine(result.local)", "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships."), std::nullopt);
```

```text
inline bool checkGlAt(const char* file,int line,PipelineStage stage, const char* api) {
    bool success = true;
    for (GLenum code = gl().GetError(); code != GL_NO_ERROR; code = gl().GetError()) {
        const char* cause = code == GL_INVALID_ENUM ? "GL_INVALID_ENUM: unsupported enum"
            : code == GL_INVALID_VALUE ? "GL_INVALID_VALUE: value outside allowed range"
            : code == GL_INVALID_OPERATION ? "GL_INVALID_OPERATION: incompatible binding, state or program"
            : code == GL_OUT_OF_MEMORY ? "GL_OUT_OF_MEMORY: GPU allocation failed"
            : code == GL_INVALID_FRAMEBUFFER_OPERATION ? "GL_INVALID_FRAMEBUFFER_OPERATION: incomplete framebuffer"
            : "OpenGL error";
        Diagnostics::failAt(file,line,stage, api, std::string(cause) + " (" + std::to_string(code) + ")",
            "Inspect this stage's bindings, buffer sizes, vertex layout, shader log and current context. A GL error does not identify a single root cause.");
        success = false;
    }
    return success;
}
```

```text
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

namespace graphics {
inline std::optional<PathPose> PatternSystem::conveyorCornerPose(double distance,const glm::vec3& start,const glm::vec3& pivot,float radius,float endZ) {
    const double straight=double(pivot.x)-start.x, arc=1.5707963267948966*radius, last=double(endZ)-pivot.z;
    if(!detail::finiteVector(start)||!detail::finiteVector(pivot)||!std::isfinite(distance)||!std::isfinite(radius)||radius<=0||!std::isfinite(endZ)||straight<=0||last<=0||std::abs(start.z-(pivot.z-radius))>1e-4f) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Motion,"conveyorCornerPose","Invalid XZ conveyor geometry.");return {};
    }
    double d=std::fmod(distance,straight+arc+last);if(d<0)d+=straight+arc+last;
    PathPose p;
    if(d<straight) {p.position=start+glm::vec3(float(d),0,0);p.tangent={1,0,0};}
    else if(d<straight+arc) {const float a=float((d-straight)/radius);p.position={pivot.x+radius*std::sin(a),start.y,pivot.z-radius*std::cos(a)};p.tangent={std::cos(a),0,std::sin(a)};}
    else {p.position={pivot.x+radius,start.y,pivot.z+float(d-straight-arc)};p.tangent={0,0,1};}
    p.yawDegrees=glm::degrees(std::atan2(p.tangent.x,p.tangent.z));return p;
}
inline bool Bounds3::valid() const {
    return detail::finiteVector(minimum) && detail::finiteVector(maximum)
        && maximum.x>minimum.x && maximum.y>minimum.y && maximum.z>minimum.z;
}
inline bool Bounds3::contains(const glm::vec3& p,const glm::vec3& margin) const {
    return valid() && detail::finiteVector(p) && detail::finiteVector(margin)
        && margin.x>=0 && margin.y>=0 && margin.z>=0
        && p.x>=minimum.x+margin.x && p.x<=maximum.x-margin.x
        && p.y>=minimum.y+margin.y && p.y<=maximum.y-margin.y
        && p.z>=minimum.z+margin.z && p.z<=maximum.z-margin.z;
}
inline bool Bounds3::overlaps(const Bounds3& b) const {
    return valid() && b.valid() && minimum.x<b.maximum.x && maximum.x>b.minimum.x
        && minimum.y<b.maximum.y && maximum.y>b.minimum.y && minimum.z<b.maximum.z && maximum.z>b.minimum.z;
}
inline bool DistancePath::setPoints(const std::vector<glm::vec3>& points,bool closed) {
    if(points.size()<2) return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Motion,"DistancePath::setPoints","Need at least two points.");
    auto candidate=points;
    for(const auto& p:candidate) if(!detail::finiteVector(p))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Motion,"DistancePath::setPoints","Path contains NaN/Inf.");
    if(closed && glm::length(glm::dvec3(candidate.front())-glm::dvec3(candidate.back()))>1e-10) candidate.push_back(candidate.front());
    std::vector<double> distances{0};
    for(std::size_t i=1;i<candidate.size();++i) {
        const double segment=glm::length(glm::dvec3(candidate[i])-glm::dvec3(candidate[i-1]));
        if(!std::isfinite(segment) || segment<=1e-10 || !std::isfinite(distances.back()+segment))
            return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Motion,"DistancePath::setPoints","Zero-length, repeated or overflowing path segment.");
        distances.push_back(distances.back()+segment);
    }
    points_=std::move(candidate);distances_=std::move(distances);return true;
}
inline std::optional<PathPose> DistancePath::sample(double distance,Playback playback) const {
    const double total=length();
    if(total<=0 || !std::isfinite(distance)) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Motion,"DistancePath::sample","Configure a nonempty path and finite distance.");return {};
    }
    double sign=1;
    if(playback==Playback::Once) distance=std::clamp(distance,0.0,total);
    else if(playback==Playback::Loop) { distance=std::fmod(distance,total);if(distance<0) distance+=total; }
    else if(playback==Playback::PingPong) {
        distance=std::fmod(distance,2*total);if(distance<0) distance+=2*total;
        if(distance>total) {distance=2*total-distance;sign=-1;}
    } else { Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Motion,"DistancePath::sample","Invalid Playback value.");return {}; }
    const auto end=std::upper_bound(distances_.begin(),distances_.end(),distance);
    const std::size_t i=end==distances_.end()?distances_.size()-1:std::size_t(end-distances_.begin());
    const float weight=float((distance-distances_[i-1])/(distances_[i]-distances_[i-1]));
    PathPose pose;pose.position=glm::mix(points_[i-1],points_[i],weight);
    pose.tangent=glm::vec3(glm::normalize(glm::dvec3(points_[i])-glm::dvec3(points_[i-1]))*sign);
    pose.yawDegrees=glm::degrees(std::atan2(pose.tangent.x,pose.tangent.z));return pose;
}
inline bool AnimationClock::advance(double dt) {
    if(!std::isfinite(dt) || dt<0 || !std::isfinite(seconds) || seconds<0 || !std::isfinite(seconds+dt))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Motion,"AnimationClock::advance","Time must be finite, nonnegative and within range.");
    if(playing) seconds+=dt;return true;
}
namespace detail {
inline bool rigidRoom(const glm::mat4& matrix) {
    const auto r=glm::mat3(matrix), identity=glm::transpose(r)*r;
    return TransformSystem::validAffine(matrix) && std::abs(glm::determinant(r)-1)<.001f
        && glm::length(identity[0]-glm::vec3(1,0,0))<.001f
        && glm::length(identity[1]-glm::vec3(0,1,0))<.001f
        && glm::length(identity[2]-glm::vec3(0,0,1))<.001f;
}
inline bool horizontalOverlap(const CharacterBody& b,const glm::vec3& feet,const Bounds3& box) {
    return feet.x+b.halfWidth.x>box.minimum.x && feet.x-b.halfWidth.x<box.maximum.x
        && feet.z+b.halfWidth.y>box.minimum.z && feet.z-b.halfWidth.y<box.maximum.z;
}
}
inline bool CollisionSystem::stepRoomBody(RoomBody& body,const Bounds3& room,const glm::mat4& roomWorld,
        float dt,bool floorOpen,bool elastic,const glm::vec3& gravity,const glm::vec3& angularVelocity) {
    if(!room.valid() || !detail::rigidRoom(roomWorld) || !detail::finiteVector(gravity)
        || !detail::finiteVector(angularVelocity) || !detail::finiteVector(body.localPosition)
        || !detail::finiteVector(body.localVelocity) || !detail::positiveLengths(body.halfExtent)
        || !detail::finiteVector(body.worldPosition) || !detail::finiteVector(body.worldVelocity)
        || !std::isfinite(dt) || dt<0 || dt>.25f) return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Motion,"CollisionSystem::stepRoomBody",
            "Need a rigid room transform, finite body state, positive half extents and dt in [0,.25].");
    const auto low=room.minimum+body.halfExtent, high=room.maximum-body.halfExtent;
    if(low.x>=high.x || low.y>=high.y || low.z>=high.z)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Motion,"CollisionSystem::stepRoomBody","Body does not fit inside the room.");
    auto next=body;
    const int steps=std::max(1,int(std::ceil(dt*120)));const float h=dt/steps;
    const auto rotation=glm::mat3(roomWorld);
    const auto localGravity=glm::transpose(rotation)*gravity;
    for(int s=0;s<steps;++s) {
        if(next.released) {next.worldVelocity+=gravity*h;next.worldPosition+=next.worldVelocity*h;continue;}
        if(!elastic) next.localVelocity+=localGravity*h;
        next.localPosition+=next.localVelocity*h;
        if(floorOpen && next.localPosition.y<low.y) {
            next.released=true;next.worldPosition=glm::vec3(roomWorld*glm::vec4(next.localPosition,1));
            next.worldVelocity=rotation*next.localVelocity+glm::cross(angularVelocity,next.worldPosition-glm::vec3(roomWorld[3]));continue;
        }
        for(int axis=0;axis<3;++axis) {
            if(elastic && !(floorOpen && axis==1)) {
                const double width=double(high[axis])-low[axis];
                const double p=double(next.localPosition[axis])-low[axis];
                double folded=std::fmod(p,2*width);if(folded<0) folded+=2*width;
                const bool reflected=folded>width;
                next.localPosition[axis]=float(low[axis]+(reflected?2*width-folded:folded));
                if(reflected) next.localVelocity[axis]=-next.localVelocity[axis];
                if(next.localPosition[axis]<=low[axis]) next.localVelocity[axis]=std::abs(next.localVelocity[axis]);
                if(next.localPosition[axis]>=high[axis]) next.localVelocity[axis]=-std::abs(next.localVelocity[axis]);
            } else {
                if(next.localPosition[axis]<low[axis] && !(floorOpen && axis==1)) {
                    next.localPosition[axis]=low[axis];next.localVelocity[axis]=elastic?std::abs(next.localVelocity[axis]):std::max(0.0f,next.localVelocity[axis]);
                }
                if(next.localPosition[axis]>high[axis]) {
                    next.localPosition[axis]=high[axis];next.localVelocity[axis]=elastic?-std::abs(next.localVelocity[axis]):std::min(0.0f,next.localVelocity[axis]);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if(!detail::finiteVector(next.localPosition) || !detail::finiteVector(next.localVelocity)
        || !detail::finiteVector(next.worldPosition) || !detail::finiteVector(next.worldVelocity))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Motion,"CollisionSystem::stepRoomBody","Simulation overflow; original state was preserved.");
    body=next;return true;
}
inline bool CollisionSystem::jump(CharacterBody& body,float speed) {
    if(!std::isfinite(speed) || speed<=0) return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Motion,"CollisionSystem::jump","Jump speed must be positive and finite.");
    if(!body.grounded) return false; // Normal input rejection, not an API error.
    body.verticalSpeed=speed;body.grounded=false;return true;
}
inline std::optional<CharacterStep> CollisionSystem::stepCharacter(CharacterBody& body,const Bounds3& stage,
        const std::vector<Bounds3>& obstacles,float dt,float gravity) {
    if(!stage.valid() || !detail::finiteVector(body.feet) || !detail::finiteVector(body.direction)
        || !std::isfinite(body.speed) || body.speed<0 || !std::isfinite(body.height) || body.height<=0
        || !std::isfinite(body.halfWidth.x) || !std::isfinite(body.halfWidth.y) || body.halfWidth.x<=0 || body.halfWidth.y<=0
        || !std::isfinite(body.verticalSpeed) || !std::isfinite(body.walkDistance)
        || !std::isfinite(dt) || dt<0 || dt>.25f || !std::isfinite(gravity) || gravity<=0) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Motion,"CollisionSystem::stepCharacter","Invalid bounds, body dimensions, speed, gravity or dt.");return {};
    }
    if(stage.maximum.x-stage.minimum.x<=2*body.halfWidth.x || stage.maximum.z-stage.minimum.z<=2*body.halfWidth.y) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Motion,"CollisionSystem::stepCharacter","Character does not fit on the stage.");return {};
    }
    float spacing=std::min(body.halfWidth.x,body.halfWidth.y)*.5f;
    for(const auto& box:obstacles) {
        if(!box.valid()) {Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Motion,"CollisionSystem::stepCharacter","Invalid obstacle bounds.");return {};}
        spacing=std::min(spacing,std::min(box.maximum.x-box.minimum.x,box.maximum.z-box.minimum.z)*.5f);
    }
    const double count=std::ceil(std::max(double(dt)*120,double(body.speed)*dt/std::max(double(spacing),1e-9)));
    if(count>4096) {Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Motion,"CollisionSystem::stepCharacter","Motion exceeds the substep budget; reduce speed or dt.");return {};}
    auto next=body;CharacterStep event;next.direction.y=0;
    const double directionLength=glm::length(glm::dvec3(next.direction));
    next.direction=directionLength>1e-10?glm::vec3(glm::dvec3(next.direction)/directionLength):glm::vec3(0);
    const int steps=std::max(1,int(count));const float h=dt/steps;
    for(int i=0;i<steps;++i) {
        const auto previous=next.feet;auto candidate=previous+next.direction*(next.speed*h);
        bool blocked=candidate.x-next.halfWidth.x<stage.minimum.x || candidate.x+next.halfWidth.x>stage.maximum.x
            || candidate.z-next.halfWidth.y<stage.minimum.z || candidate.z+next.halfWidth.y>stage.maximum.z;
        for(const auto& box:obstacles) if(previous.y<box.maximum.y-1e-4f && previous.y+next.height>box.minimum.y+1e-4f
            && detail::horizontalOverlap(next,candidate,box)) blocked=true;
        if(blocked) {next.direction=-next.direction;candidate=previous;event.blocked=event.turned=true;}
        next.feet=candidate;next.walkDistance+=glm::length(glm::dvec2(candidate.x-previous.x,candidate.z-previous.z));
        bool supported=std::abs(next.feet.y-stage.minimum.y)<1e-4f;
        for(const auto& box:obstacles) if(detail::horizontalOverlap(next,next.feet,box) && std::abs(next.feet.y-box.maximum.y)<1e-4f) supported=true;
        if(next.grounded && !supported) next.grounded=false;
        if(!next.grounded) {
            const float oldY=next.feet.y;next.verticalSpeed-=gravity*h;float newY=oldY+next.verticalSpeed*h;
            float landing=stage.minimum.y;
            for(const auto& box:obstacles) if(detail::horizontalOverlap(next,next.feet,box)) {
                if(next.verticalSpeed<=0 && oldY>=box.maximum.y-1e-4f && newY<=box.maximum.y) landing=std::max(landing,box.maximum.y);
                if(next.verticalSpeed>0 && oldY+next.height<=box.minimum.y && newY+next.height>=box.minimum.y) {
                    newY=box.minimum.y-next.height;next.verticalSpeed=0;
                }
            }
            if(next.verticalSpeed<=0 && newY<=landing && oldY>=landing-1e-4f) {
                newY=landing;next.verticalSpeed=0;next.grounded=true;event.landed=true;
            }
            next.feet.y=newY;
        }
    }
    if(!detail::finiteVector(next.feet) || !std::isfinite(next.walkDistance) || !std::isfinite(next.verticalSpeed)) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Motion,"CollisionSystem::stepCharacter","Simulation overflow; original state was preserved.");return {};
    }
    body=next;return event;
}
inline std::optional<Bounds3> CollisionSystem::randomFreeBox(const Bounds3& area,const glm::vec3& size,
        const std::vector<Bounds3>& occupied,std::mt19937& random,unsigned attempts) {
    if(!area.valid() || !detail::positiveLengths(size) || attempts==0 || attempts>100000
        || size.x>area.maximum.x-area.minimum.x || size.y>area.maximum.y-area.minimum.y || size.z>area.maximum.z-area.minimum.z) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Scene,"CollisionSystem::randomFreeBox","Box must fit in the area; attempts must be in [1,100000].");return {};
    }
    for(const auto& box:occupied) if(!box.valid()) {Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Scene,"CollisionSystem::randomFreeBox","Invalid occupied bounds.");return {};}
    for(unsigned i=0;i<attempts;++i) {
        Bounds3 box;
        for(int axis=0;axis<3;++axis) box.minimum[axis]=std::uniform_real_distribution<float>(area.minimum[axis],area.maximum[axis]-size[axis])(random);
        box.maximum=box.minimum+size;
        if(std::none_of(occupied.begin(),occupied.end(),[&](const Bounds3& other){return box.overlaps(other);})) return box;
    }
    Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Scene,"CollisionSystem::randomFreeBox","No free placement within the attempt budget.","Use smaller objects, fewer occupied regions or a larger placement area.");return {};
}
inline std::optional<EntityId> PatternSystem::addBox(Scene& scene,const glm::vec3& size,const glm::vec3& position,
        GlColor color,std::optional<EntityId> parent) {
    if(!detail::positiveLengths(size) || !detail::finiteVector(position) || !detail::validColor(color) || (parent && !scene.getComponent(*parent))) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Scene,"PatternSystem::addBox","Need positive dimensions, finite position/color and an existing parent.");return {};
    }
    auto model=DiagramSystem::makePolyhedron(GLShape::Cube,size);for(auto& face:model.faces) face.color=color;
    Transform3D transform;transform.basis=position;
    const auto entity=scene.addModel(model,transform,PivotMode::Preserve);
    if(!entity || !scene.setParent(*entity,parent)) return {};return entity;
}
inline std::optional<EntityId> PatternSystem::addPolygon(Scene& scene,const std::vector<glm::vec3>& points,
        GlColor color,std::optional<EntityId> parent) {
    if(points.size()<3 || !detail::validColor(color) || (parent && !scene.getComponent(*parent))) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Scene,"PatternSystem::addPolygon","Need a convex polygon (>=3 points), valid color and parent.");return {};
    }
    Mesh face;face.localVertices=points;face.color=color;
    for(std::size_t i=1;i+1<points.size();++i) face.triangleIndices.insert(face.triangleIndices.end(),{0,std::uint32_t(i),std::uint32_t(i+1)});
    recalculateNormals(face);Model model;model.faces.push_back(face);
    const auto entity=scene.addModel(model,Transform3D{},PivotMode::Preserve);
    if(!entity || !scene.setParent(*entity,parent)) return {};return entity;
}
inline std::optional<EntityId> PatternSystem::addRoom(Scene& scene,const Bounds3& bounds,bool frontOpen) {
    if(!bounds.valid()) {Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Scene,"PatternSystem::addRoom","Room bounds must have positive finite extents.");return {};}
    auto model=DiagramSystem::makePolyhedron(GLShape::Cube,bounds.maximum-bounds.minimum);
    for(auto& face:model.faces) {face.cull=CullMode::Front;recalculateNormals(face);for(auto& normal:face.vertexNormals) normal=-normal;}
    model.faces[0].visible=!frontOpen;
    Transform3D transform;transform.basis=(bounds.minimum+bounds.maximum)*.5f;
    return scene.addModel(model,transform,PivotMode::Preserve);
}
inline std::optional<EntityId> PatternSystem::addJoint(Scene& scene,EntityId parent,const glm::vec3& anchor) {
    if(!scene.getComponent(parent) || !detail::finiteVector(anchor)) {Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Scene,"PatternSystem::addJoint","Missing parent or non-finite anchor.");return {};}
    Transform3D transform;transform.basis=anchor;const auto joint=scene.addGroup(transform);
    if(!joint || !scene.setParent(*joint,parent)) return {};return joint;
}
inline bool PatternSystem::rotateJoint(Scene& scene,EntityId joint,const glm::vec3& axis,float degrees) {
    const auto* component=scene.getComponent(joint);const auto rotation=TransformSystem::rotation({{0,0,0},axis},degrees);
    if(!component || !rotation) return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Transform,"PatternSystem::rotateJoint","Missing joint or invalid rotation.");
    auto transform=component->transform;transform.rotation=glm::mat3(*rotation);return scene.setTransform(joint,transform);
}
inline bool PatternSystem::follow(Scene& scene,EntityId entity,const DistancePath& path,double distance,const glm::vec3& offset,bool orient) {
    const auto pose=path.sample(distance);const auto* component=scene.getComponent(entity);
    if(!pose || !component || !detail::finiteVector(offset)) return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Motion,"PatternSystem::follow","Invalid path sample, entity or offset.");
    auto transform=component->transform;transform.basis=pose->position+offset;
    if(orient) transform.rotation=glm::mat3(glm::rotate(glm::mat4(1),glm::radians(pose->yawDegrees),glm::vec3(0,1,0)));
    return scene.setTransform(entity,transform);
}
inline bool PatternSystem::addNumber(Scene& scene,unsigned digit,const glm::vec3& position,float height,GlColor color,std::optional<EntityId> parent) {
    if(digit>9 || !detail::finiteVector(position) || !std::isfinite(height) || height<=0 || !detail::validColor(color) || (parent && !scene.getComponent(*parent)))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Scene,"PatternSystem::addNumber","Need digit 0-9, positive height, finite values and a valid parent.");
    constexpr unsigned masks[10]={0x3f,0x06,0x5b,0x4f,0x66,0x6d,0x7d,0x07,0x7f,0x6f};
    const glm::vec2 endpoints[7][2]={{{0,1},{.5f,1}},{{.5f,1},{.5f,.5f}},{{.5f,.5f},{.5f,0}},{{0,0},{.5f,0}},{{0,.5f},{0,0}},{{0,1},{0,.5f}},{{0,.5f},{.5f,.5f}}};
    for(unsigned i=0;i<7;++i) if(masks[digit]&(1u<<i)) {
        const auto a=position+glm::vec3(endpoints[i][0]*height,0),b=position+glm::vec3(endpoints[i][1]*height,0);
        if(!scene.addLine(a,b,color,parent)) return false;
    }
    return true;
}
inline bool PatternSystem::foldFace(Scene& scene,EntityId entity,std::size_t face,const AxisLine& hinge,float degrees) {
    const auto matrix=TransformSystem::rotation(hinge,degrees);return matrix && scene.setFaceLocalMatrix(entity,face,*matrix);
}
inline bool PatternSystem::openFace(Scene& scene,EntityId entity,std::size_t face,float progress,
        const glm::vec3& displacement,const glm::vec3& topPivot,bool scaleOpen) {
    if(!std::isfinite(progress) || progress<0 || progress>1 || !detail::finiteVector(displacement) || !detail::finiteVector(topPivot))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Transform,"PatternSystem::openFace","Need progress in [0,1] and finite vectors.");
    if(scaleOpen) {
        // Fully open faces are hidden; retain a nonsingular matrix for normals/picking.
        const auto scale=TransformSystem::scaling({1,std::max(1e-4f,1-progress),1},topPivot);
        return scale && scene.setFaceLocalMatrix(entity,face,*scale) && scene.setFaceVisible(entity,face,progress<1);
    }
    return scene.setFaceLocalMatrix(entity,face,glm::translate(glm::mat4(1),displacement*progress)) && scene.setFaceVisible(entity,face,true);
}
inline std::optional<std::size_t> PatternSystem::cameraFacingWall(const Scene& scene,EntityId room,const Camera& camera) {
    const auto* component=scene.getComponent(room);const auto world=scene.worldMatrix(room);
    if(!component || component->polyhedron.faces.size()!=6 || !world || !CameraSystem::validCamera(camera)
        || std::abs(glm::determinant(glm::mat3(*world)))<1e-8f) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Transform,"cameraFacingWall","Need a six-face room, invertible world transform and valid camera.");return {};
    }
    const auto view=glm::normalize(camera.target-camera.position);
    const auto normals=glm::transpose(glm::inverse(glm::mat3(*world)));
    float best=0;std::optional<std::size_t> selected;
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<4;++i) {
        const auto& vertices=component->polyhedron.faces[i].localVertices;
        if(vertices.size()<3) return {};
        const auto n=glm::normalize(normals*glm::cross(vertices[1]-vertices[0],vertices[2]-vertices[0]));
        const float score=glm::dot(n,view);
        if(score<best-1e-6f) {best=score;selected=i;}
    }
    return selected; // A vertical view has no opposing side wall; normal query miss.
}
inline bool PatternSystem::openRoomWall(Scene& scene,EntityId room,std::size_t face,float progress) {
    const auto* mesh=scene.getMesh(room,face);
    if(!mesh || face>=4 || mesh->localVertices.empty())
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Scene,"openRoomWall","Select one of the four side walls of addRoom().");
    glm::vec3 pivot(0);float top=mesh->localVertices.front().y;
    for(const auto& vertex:mesh->localVertices) {pivot+=vertex;top=std::max(top,vertex.y);}
    pivot/=float(mesh->localVertices.size());pivot.y=top;
    return openFace(scene,room,face,progress,glm::vec3(0),pivot,true);
}
inline bool PatternSystem::swapModels(Scene& scene,EntityId first,EntityId second) {
    const auto* a=scene.getComponent(first);const auto* b=scene.getComponent(second);
    if(!a || !b || a->transformOnly || b->transformOnly) return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Scene,"PatternSystem::swapModels","Both entities must contain a model.");
    const auto firstModel=a->polyhedron,secondModel=b->polyhedron;
    if(!scene.setModel(first,secondModel)) return false;
    if(!scene.setModel(second,firstModel)) {scene.setModel(first,firstModel);return false;}
    return true;
}
inline std::vector<glm::ivec3> PatternSystem::snakeCells(const glm::ivec3& cells) {
    std::vector<glm::ivec3> result;
    if(cells.x<=0 || cells.y!=1 || cells.z<=0 || std::uint64_t(cells.x)*cells.z>1000000) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Motion,"PatternSystem::snakeCells","Need an XZ grid with y=1 and at most 1,000,000 cells.");return result;
    }
    for(int z=0;z<cells.z;++z) for(int x=0;x<cells.x;++x) result.push_back({z%2?cells.x-1-x:x,0,z});return result;
}
inline bool PatternSystem::aligned(float first,float second,float tolerance) {
    if(!std::isfinite(first) || !std::isfinite(second) || !std::isfinite(tolerance) || tolerance<0)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Motion,"PatternSystem::aligned","Need finite heights and nonnegative tolerance.");
    return std::abs(double(first)-second)<=tolerance;
}
inline glm::vec3 PatternSystem::snap(const glm::vec3& point,float spacing) {
    if(!detail::finiteVector(point) || !std::isfinite(spacing) || spacing<=0) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Transform,"PatternSystem::snap","Need finite point and positive spacing.");return point;
    }
    const auto result=glm::vec3(glm::round(glm::dvec3(point)/double(spacing))*double(spacing));
    if(!detail::finiteVector(result)) {Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Transform,"PatternSystem::snap","Snap overflow.");return point;}return result;
}
inline std::optional<glm::vec3> PatternSystem::screenOnPlane(const Camera& camera,double x,double y,const PickViewport& viewport,
        const glm::vec3& planePoint,const glm::vec3& normal) {
    const auto ray=screenRay(camera,x,y,viewport);const auto n=detail::motionUnitVector(normal);
    if(!ray || !n || !detail::finiteVector(planePoint)) {Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Input,"PatternSystem::screenOnPlane","Invalid camera, viewport, pointer or plane.");return {};}
    const double denominator=glm::dot(glm::dvec3(ray->direction),glm::dvec3(*n));
    if(std::abs(denominator)<1e-10) return {};
    const double t=glm::dot(glm::dvec3(planePoint)-glm::dvec3(ray->origin),glm::dvec3(*n))/denominator;
    if(t<0 || t>ray->maxDistance) return {};return glm::vec3(glm::dvec3(ray->origin)+glm::dvec3(ray->direction)*t);
}
inline bool PatternSystem::moveCamera(Camera& camera,const glm::vec3& offset) {
    auto next=camera;next.position+=offset;next.target+=offset;
    if(!CameraSystem::validCamera(next)) return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Transform,"PatternSystem::moveCamera","Camera translation creates an invalid camera.");
    camera=next;return true;
}
inline bool PatternSystem::yawCamera(Camera& camera,float degrees) {
    if(!CameraSystem::validCamera(camera)) return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Transform,"PatternSystem::yawCamera","Invalid camera.");
    const auto forward=glm::normalize(camera.target-camera.position),right=glm::normalize(glm::cross(forward,camera.up));
    const auto up=glm::normalize(glm::cross(right,forward));const auto rotation=TransformSystem::rotation({camera.position,up},degrees);

    if(!CameraSystem::validCamera(next)) return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Transform,"PatternSystem::yawCamera","Rotation creates an invalid camera.");

    const auto rotation=TransformSystem::rotation(axis,degrees);if(!rotation) return false;

    next.target=glm::vec3(*rotation*glm::vec4(camera.target,1));next.up=glm::mat3(*rotation)*camera.up;

    if(!std::isfinite(factor) || factor<=0) return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Transform,"PatternSystem::zoomCamera","Zoom factor must be positive and finite.");

inline std::vector<RenderPass> PatternSystem::threeViews(const Camera& perspective,int width,int height,const RenderOptions& options) {
    if(width<3 || height<2 || !CameraSystem::validCamera(perspective)) {

    }

    RenderPass top=main;top.viewport={left,bottom,right,height-bottom};top.camera.orthographic=true;
    top.camera.position=perspective.target+glm::vec3(0,20,0);top.camera.target=perspective.target;top.camera.up={0,0,-1};
    top.camera.orthographicHalfExtent=std::max(6.5f,perspective.orthographicHalfExtent);

inline std::optional<JointRig> PatternSystem::addWalkingRig(Scene& scene,const GridLayout& grid) {
    if(!grid.valid() || !detail::rigidRoom(grid.frame)) {Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Scene,"PatternSystem::addWalkingRig","Need a valid grid with a rigid frame.");return {};}
    JointRig rig;const auto root=scene.addGroup();if(!root) return {};rig.root=*root;
    auto point=[&](glm::vec3 ratio){return grid.origin+grid.extent*ratio;};
    const auto torso=addBox(scene,grid.extent*glm::vec3(.45f,.35f,.7f),point({.5f,.58f,.5f}),{.65f,.65f,.7f},rig.root);
    const auto head=addJoint(scene,rig.root,point({.5f,.8f,.5f}));if(!torso || !head) return {};rig.head=*head;
    if(!addBox(scene,grid.extent*glm::vec3(.3f,.2f,.6f),{0,grid.extent.y*.1f,0},{1,.8f,.5f},rig.head)
        || !addBox(scene,grid.extent*glm::vec3(.1f,.05f,.2f),{0,grid.extent.y*.1f,grid.extent.z*.4f},{1,.2f,.2f},rig.head)) return {};
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<2;++i) {
        const float x=i==0?.2f:.8f;const GlColor color=i==0?GlColor{.2f,.6f,1}:GlColor{1,.4f,.2f};
        const auto shoulder=addJoint(scene,rig.root,point({x,.72f,.5f})),hip=addJoint(scene,rig.root,point({i==0?.35f:.65f,.4f,.5f}));
        if(!shoulder || !hip) return {};rig.shoulders[i]=*shoulder;rig.hips[i]=*hip;
        if(!addBox(scene,grid.extent*glm::vec3(.15f,.32f,.3f),{0,-grid.extent.y*.16f,0},color,*shoulder)
            || !addBox(scene,grid.extent*glm::vec3(.18f,.4f,.4f),{0,-grid.extent.y*.2f,0},color,*hip)) return {};
    }
    Transform3D transform;transform.rotation=glm::mat3(grid.frame);transform.basis=glm::vec3(grid.frame[3]);
    if(!scene.setTransform(rig.root,transform)) return {};return rig;

inline bool PatternSystem::poseWalkingRig(Scene& scene,const JointRig& rig,const glm::vec3& feet,float yawDegrees,double distance,float speed) {
    if(!detail::finiteVector(feet) || !std::isfinite(yawDegrees) || !std::isfinite(distance) || !std::isfinite(speed) || speed<0)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Motion,"PatternSystem::poseWalkingRig","Need finite pose values and nonnegative speed.");
    const auto* root=scene.getComponent(rig.root);
    if(!root || !scene.getComponent(rig.head)) return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Scene,"PatternSystem::poseWalkingRig","Rig IDs are missing or stale.");
    for(auto id:rig.shoulders) if(!scene.getComponent(id)) return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Scene,"PatternSystem::poseWalkingRig","Shoulder joint is missing.");
    for(auto id:rig.hips) if(!scene.getComponent(id)) return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Scene,"PatternSystem::poseWalkingRig","Hip joint is missing.");
    auto transform=root->transform;transform.basis=feet;
    transform.rotation=glm::mat3(glm::rotate(glm::mat4(1),glm::radians(yawDegrees),glm::vec3(0,1,0)));
    if(!scene.setTransform(rig.root,transform)) return false;
    const float angle=std::min(50.0f,15+speed*12)*float(std::sin(std::remainder(distance,1.0)*6.283185307179586));
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<2;++i) {
        const float sign=i==0?1.0f:-1.0f;
        if(!rotateJoint(scene,rig.hips[i],{1,0,0},sign*angle) || !rotateJoint(scene,rig.shoulders[i],{1,0,0},-sign*angle)) return false;
    }
    return true;
}
```

적용 경로:

- `framework/detail/Renderer.inl`
- `openGL_3dAssign_15/framework/detail/Renderer.inl`

- `openGL_3dAssign_17/framework/detail/Renderer.inl`
- `openGL_3dAssign_18/framework/detail/Renderer.inl`
- `openGL_3dAssign_19/framework/detail/Renderer.inl`
- `standard/framework/detail/Renderer.inl`

```text

inline std::string readTextFile(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
    std::ifstream input(path,std::ios::binary);
    if(!input) return {};
    std::ostringstream buffer;buffer<<input.rdbuf();auto text=buffer.str();
    if(text.compare(0,3,"\xEF\xBB\xBF")==0) text.erase(0,3);

}
namespace detail {
inline GLuint compileShader(GLenum kind,const std::string& sourceText) {
    auto& api=gl();const auto shader=api.CreateShader(kind);if(!shader)return 0;
    const char* text=sourceText.c_str();api.ShaderSource(shader,1,&text,nullptr);api.CompileShader(shader);
    GLint success=0;api.GetShaderiv(shader,GL_COMPILE_STATUS,&success);
    if(!success) {
        GLint length=0;api.GetShaderiv(shader,GL_INFO_LOG_LENGTH,&length);
        std::string log(std::max(length,1), '\0');api.GetShaderInfoLog(shader,GLsizei(log.size()),nullptr,log.data());
        std::cerr<<"Shader compile failed: "<<log<<'\n';api.DeleteShader(shader);return 0;
    }
    return shader;
}

inline GLuint uploadTexture(const TextureImage& image,bool repeat) {
    auto& api=gl();GLuint id=0;api.GenTextures(1,&id);if(!id)return 0;
    api.ActiveTexture(GL_TEXTURE0);api.BindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D,id);

    api.PixelStorei(GL_UNPACK_ALIGNMENT,1);

    api.PixelStorei(GL_UNPACK_ALIGNMENT,previousAlignment);
    api.TexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D,GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER,GL_LINEAR);
    api.TexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D,GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER,GL_LINEAR);
    api.TexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D,GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_S,repeat?GL_REPEAT:GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    api.TexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D,GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_T,repeat?GL_REPEAT:GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    if(api.GetError()!=GL_NO_ERROR) {api.DeleteTextures(1,&id);return 0;}
    return id;

} // namespace detail

inline bool Renderer::initShader(const std::filesystem::path& vertexPath,const std::filesystem::path& fragmentPath) {
    auto& gl=detail::gl();
    const auto vertexText=vertexPath.empty()?std::string(detail::vertexShader):readTextFile(vertexPath);
    const auto fragmentText=fragmentPath.empty()?std::string(detail::fragmentShader):readTextFile(fragmentPath);

    const auto fragment=detail::compileShader(GL_FRAGMENT_SHADER,fragmentText);

    hasTextureLocation_=gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_,"uHasTexture");
    lightingLocation_=gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_,"uLighting");
    lightDirectionLocation_=gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_,"uLightDirection");
    lightColorLocation_=gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_,"uLightColor");
    overrideLocation_=gl.GetUniformLocation(shaderProgramID_,"uOverrideColor");
```

```text
    const auto fragment=detail::compileShader(GL_FRAGMENT_SHADER,fragmentText,fragmentPath.empty()?embeddedSource:fragmentPath);
```

## framework/detail/Scene.inl

공통 계산·변환·렌더링을 API로 제공하고 각 독립 프로젝트에 같은 구현을 배포한다.

적용 경로:

- `framework/detail/Scene.inl`
- `openGL_3dAssign_15/framework/detail/Scene.inl`

```text
#pragma once

namespace graphics {

inline bool positiveLengths(const glm::vec3& value) {
    return finiteVector(value) && value.x > 0.0f
        && value.y > 0.0f && value.z > 0.0f;
}

inline std::uint64_t nextGeometryRevision() {
    // 장면 복사·교체 시에도 다른 형상에 같은 revision을 부여하지 않는다.
    // Scene과 Renderer는 한 렌더링 스레드에서 사용한다.
    static std::uint64_t revision = 0;
    return ++revision;
}

inline void appendFace(Polyhedron& polyhedron, GLFace shape,
                std::initializer_list<glm::vec3> vertices, GlColor color) {
    PlaneFigure face;
    face.shape = shape;
    face.localVertices = vertices;
    face.color = color;
    face.normal = glm::normalize(glm::cross(
        face.localVertices[1] - face.localVertices[0],
        face.localVertices[2] - face.localVertices[0]));
    polyhedron.faces.push_back(face);
}

} // namespace detail
using detail::finiteVector;
using detail::finiteMatrix;
using detail::validColor;
using detail::positiveLengths;
using detail::nextGeometryRevision;
using detail::appendFace;

inline Scene::Scene() {
    geometryRevision_ = nextGeometryRevision();
    polyId_.reserve(MAX_ENTITIES);
    components_.reserve(MAX_ENTITIES);
    tetraFaceId_.reserve(MAX_ENTITIES * 4);
    cubeFaceId_.reserve(MAX_ENTITIES * 6);
    pyramidFaceId_.reserve(MAX_ENTITIES * 5);
    lines_.reserve(MAX_LINES);
}

inline std::optional<EntityId> Scene::addGroup(const Transform3D& transform) {
    if(!DiagramSystem::validTransform(transform))return {};
    const auto id=components_.size();
    Component_Poly group;group.polyhedron.shape=GLShape::None;
    group.transform=transform;group.sideLengths=glm::vec3(0);group.transformOnly=true;
    components_.push_back(group);polyId_.push_back(id);
    geometryRevision_=nextGeometryRevision();return id;
}

    components_[id].tint=color;return true;

    Transform3D transform;transform.basis=position;

inline std::optional<EntityId> Scene::addCone(float radius,float height,const glm::vec3& position,unsigned slices) {

inline std::optional<EntityId> Scene::push_entity(
    const Polyhedron& polyhedron, const Transform3D& transform
) {
    if (!DiagramSystem::validPolyhedron(polyhedron)
        || !DiagramSystem::validTransform(transform)) {
        return std::nullopt;
    }
    glm::vec3 minimum = polyhedron.faces[0].localVertices[0];
    glm::vec3 maximum = minimum;
    for (const PlaneFigure& face : polyhedron.faces) {
        for (const glm::vec3& vertex : face.localVertices) {
            minimum = glm::min(minimum, vertex);
            maximum = glm::max(maximum, vertex);
        }
    }
    if (!finiteVector(maximum - minimum)) return {};
    const EntityId id = components_.size();
    components_.push_back({ polyhedron, transform, maximum - minimum });
    polyId_.push_back(id);
    std::vector<FaceId>* faceIds = nullptr;
    if (polyhedron.shape == GLShape::Cube) faceIds = &cubeFaceId_;
    if (polyhedron.shape == GLShape::Tetra) faceIds = &tetraFaceId_;
    if (polyhedron.shape == GLShape::Pyramid) faceIds = &pyramidFaceId_;
    if (faceIds) for (std::size_t i = 0; i < polyhedron.faces.size(); ++i)
        faceIds->push_back({id, i});
    geometryRevision_ = nextGeometryRevision();
    return id;
}

inline bool Scene::setFaceVisible(EntityId id, std::size_t faceIndex, bool visible) {
    if (id >= components_.size()
        || faceIndex >= components_[id].polyhedron.faces.size()) {
        return false;
    }
    components_[id].polyhedron.faces[faceIndex].visible = visible;
    return true;
}

inline bool Scene::setFaceLocalMatrix(EntityId id, std::size_t faceIndex,
                               const glm::mat4& matrix) {
    if (id >= components_.size()
        || faceIndex >= components_[id].polyhedron.faces.size()
        || !finiteMatrix(matrix)) {
        return false;
    }
    components_[id].polyhedron.faces[faceIndex].localAnimationMatrix = matrix;
    return true;
}

inline bool Scene::setFaceVertexColors(EntityId id, std::size_t faceIndex,
                                const std::vector<GlColor>& colors) {
    if (id >= components_.size()
        || faceIndex >= components_[id].polyhedron.faces.size()) {
        return false;
    }
    PlaneFigure& face = components_[id].polyhedron.faces[faceIndex];
    if (!colors.empty() && colors.size() != face.localVertices.size()) {
        return false;
    }
    for (GlColor color : colors) {
        if (!validColor(color)) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    face.vertexColors = colors;
    geometryRevision_ = nextGeometryRevision();
    return true;
}

inline const Component_Poly* Scene::getComponent(EntityId id) const {
    return id < components_.size() ? &components_[id] : nullptr;
}

inline bool Scene::setPosition(EntityId id, const glm::vec3& worldPosition) {
    // For a parented entity this position is in parent coordinates.
    if (id >= components_.size() || !finiteVector(worldPosition)) {
        return false;
    }
    auto candidate = components_[id].transform;
    candidate.basis = worldPosition;
    return setTransform(id, candidate);
}

inline bool Scene::setSideLengths(EntityId id, const glm::vec3& sideLengths) {
    if(id>=components_.size()||!positiveLengths(sideLengths))return false;
    const auto& c=components_[id];
    if(c.transformOnly)return false;
    auto replacement=c.polyhedron;
    const auto box=detail::bounds(replacement);const auto oldSize=box.second-box.first;
    if(!positiveLengths(oldSize))return false;
    const auto ratio=sideLengths/oldSize;
    if(!finiteVector(ratio))return false;
    // Preserve topology/materials. Resize mesh coordinates around the model pivot.
    for(auto& face:replacement.faces) {
        for(auto& vertex:face.localVertices)vertex=c.transform.localBasis+(vertex-c.transform.localBasis)*ratio;
        face.transform.localBasis=c.transform.localBasis+(face.transform.localBasis-c.transform.localBasis)*ratio;
        recalculateNormals(face);
    }
    return setModel(id,replacement);
}

inline bool Scene::setParent(EntityId id, std::optional<EntityId> parent) {
    if (id >= components_.size()) return false;
    auto ancestor = parent;
    std::size_t remaining = components_.size();
    while (ancestor) {
        if (*ancestor >= components_.size() || *ancestor == id || remaining-- == 0) return false;
        ancestor = components_[*ancestor].parent;
    }
    components_[id].parent = parent;
    return true;
}
inline std::optional<glm::mat4> Scene::worldMatrix(EntityId id) const {
    if (id >= components_.size()) return {};
    std::vector<EntityId> chain;
    std::optional<EntityId> current = id;
    while (current) {
        if (*current >= components_.size() || chain.size() >= components_.size()) return {};
        chain.push_back(*current);
        current = components_[*current].parent;
    }
    std::reverse(chain.begin(), chain.end());
    LayerId layer = MotionSystem::rootLayer();
    std::size_t anchor = chain.size() - 1;
    for (std::size_t i = chain.size(); i > 0; --i) {
        const auto binding = getEntityLayer(chain[i - 1]);
        if (binding) { layer = *binding; anchor = i - 1; break; }
    }
    const auto motion = motions_.layerMatrices(layer);
    if (!motion) return {};
    glm::mat4 prefix(1), suffix(1);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < chain.size(); ++i) {
        auto& matrix = i <= anchor ? prefix : suffix;
        matrix *= detail::transformMatrix(components_[chain[i]].transform);
    }
    const auto result = motion->parent * prefix * motion->local * suffix;
    return detail::finiteMatrix(result) ? std::optional<glm::mat4>(result) : std::nullopt;
}
inline std::optional<glm::mat4> Scene::faceWorldMatrix(EntityId id, std::size_t faceIndex) const {
    if (id >= components_.size() || faceIndex >= components_[id].polyhedron.faces.size()) return {};
    const auto world = worldMatrix(id);
    if (!world) return {};
    const auto& face = components_[id].polyhedron.faces[faceIndex];
    glm::mat4 child(1);
    if (face.independence)
        child = glm::translate(glm::mat4(1), face.transform.localBasis)
              * detail::transformMatrix(face.transform);
    const auto result = *world * child * face.localAnimationMatrix;
    return detail::finiteMatrix(result) ? std::optional<glm::mat4>(result) : std::nullopt;
}
inline std::optional<glm::mat4> Scene::lineWorldMatrix(LineId id) const {
    if (id >= lines_.size()) return {};
    if (lines_[id].owner) return worldMatrix(*lines_[id].owner);
    const auto global = motions_.layerMatrices(MotionSystem::rootLayer());
    return global ? std::optional<glm::mat4>(global->parent * global->local) : std::nullopt;
}
inline bool Scene::bindEntity(EntityId id, LayerId layer) {
    if (id >= components_.size() || !motions_.getLayer(layer)) return false;
    entityLayers_[id] = layer;
    return true;
}
inline bool Scene::unbindEntity(EntityId id) {
    if (id >= components_.size()) return false;
    entityLayers_.erase(id);
    return true;
}
inline std::optional<LayerId> Scene::getEntityLayer(EntityId id) const {
    if (id >= components_.size()) return {};
    const auto found = entityLayers_.find(id);
    if (found == entityLayers_.end() || !motions_.getLayer(found->second)) return {};
    return found->second;
}

inline bool Scene::setTransform(EntityId id, const Transform3D& transform) {
    if (id >= components_.size() || !DiagramSystem::validTransform(transform)) {
        return false;
    }
    components_[id].transform = transform;
    return true;
}

inline bool Scene::setFaceTransform(
    EntityId id, std::size_t faceIndex,
    const Transform3D& transform, bool independence
) {
    if (id >= components_.size()
        || faceIndex >= components_[id].polyhedron.faces.size()
        || !DiagramSystem::validTransform(transform)) {
        return false;
    }
    PlaneFigure& face = components_[id].polyhedron.faces[faceIndex];
    face.transform = transform;
    face.independence = independence;
    return true;
}

inline std::optional<LineId> Scene::addLine(
    const glm::vec3& start, const glm::vec3& end,
    GlColor color, std::optional<EntityId> owner
) {
    if (!finiteVector(start) || !finiteVector(end)
        || !validColor(color) || (owner && getComponent(*owner) == nullptr)) {
        return std::nullopt;
    }
    const LineId id = lines_.size();
    lines_.push_back({ start, end, color, owner });
    geometryRevision_ = nextGeometryRevision();
    return id;
}

inline std::optional<LineId> Scene::addVector(
    const glm::vec3& origin, const glm::vec3& vector,
    GlColor color, std::optional<EntityId> owner
) {
    return addLine(origin, origin + vector, color, owner);
}

inline std::optional<std::array<LineId, 3>> Scene::addBasis(
    const glm::vec3& origin, const glm::mat3& basisVectors,
    const glm::vec3& axisLengths, std::optional<EntityId> owner
) {
    if (!finiteVector(origin)
        || !positiveLengths(axisLengths)
        || (owner && getComponent(*owner) == nullptr)) {
        return std::nullopt;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        if (!finiteVector(basisVectors[i])
            || glm::dot(basisVectors[i], basisVectors[i]) <= 0.0f
            || !finiteVector(origin + basisVectors[i] * axisLengths[i])) {
            return std::nullopt;
        }
    }
    // 사전 검증 후 세 선을 함께 등록한다. 실패 입력은 장면을 변경하지 않는다.
    const std::array<GlColor, 3> colors{
        GlColor{ 1.0f, 0.2f, 0.2f },
        GlColor{ 0.2f, 1.0f, 0.2f },
        GlColor{ 0.2f, 0.4f, 1.0f }
    };
    std::array<LineId, 3> ids{};
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        ids[i] = lines_.size();
        lines_.push_back({
            origin, origin + basisVectors[i] * axisLengths[i], colors[i], owner });
    }
    geometryRevision_ = nextGeometryRevision();
    return ids;
}

inline bool Scene::setVector(LineId id, const glm::vec3& origin, const glm::vec3& vector) {
    if (id >= lines_.size() || !finiteVector(origin)
        || !finiteVector(origin + vector)) {
        return false;
    }
    lines_[id].start = origin;
    lines_[id].end = origin + vector;
    geometryRevision_ = nextGeometryRevision();
    return true;
}

inline void Scene::clear() {
    motions_.clear();
    entityLayers_.clear();
    if (components_.empty() && lines_.empty()) {
        return;
    }
    polyId_.clear();
    components_.clear();
    cubeFaceId_.clear();
    tetraFaceId_.clear();
    pyramidFaceId_.clear();
    lines_.clear();
    geometryRevision_ = nextGeometryRevision();
}

inline bool DiagramSystem::validTransform(const Transform3D& transform) {
    return finiteVector(transform.basis) && finiteVector(transform.localBasis)
        && finiteVector(transform.scale)
        && finiteVector(transform.rotation[0]) && finiteVector(transform.rotation[1])
        && finiteVector(transform.rotation[2])
        && std::abs(glm::determinant(transform.rotation) - 1.0f) < 0.01f
        && glm::length(glm::transpose(transform.rotation) * transform.rotation[0] - glm::vec3(1,0,0)) < 0.01f
        && glm::length(glm::transpose(transform.rotation) * transform.rotation[1] - glm::vec3(0,1,0)) < 0.01f
        && glm::length(glm::transpose(transform.rotation) * transform.rotation[2] - glm::vec3(0,0,1)) < 0.01f
        && finiteMatrix(detail::transformMatrix(transform));
}

inline bool DiagramSystem::validPolyhedron(const Polyhedron& polyhedron) {
    if (polyhedron.faces.empty()) return false;
    for (const auto& face : polyhedron.faces)
        if (!detail::validMesh(face) || !validTransform(face.transform)) return false;
    return true;
}

inline Polyhedron DiagramSystem::makePolyhedron(GLShape shape, const glm::vec3& sideLengths) {
    Polyhedron polyhedron;
    if (!positiveLengths(sideLengths)) {
        return polyhedron;
    }
    polyhedron.shape = shape;
    if (shape == GLShape::Cube) {
        const float x = sideLengths.x * 0.5f;
        const float y = sideLengths.y * 0.5f;
        const float z = sideLengths.z * 0.5f;
        polyhedron.faces.reserve(6);
        appendFace(polyhedron, GLFace::Rect,
            { { -x, -y, z }, { x, -y, z }, { x, y, z }, { -x, y, z } },
            { .9f, .3f, .3f });
        appendFace(polyhedron, GLFace::Rect,
            { { x, -y, -z }, { -x, -y, -z }, { -x, y, -z }, { x, y, -z } },
            { .3f, .8f, .4f });
        appendFace(polyhedron, GLFace::Rect,
            { { -x, -y, -z }, { -x, -y, z }, { -x, y, z }, { -x, y, -z } },
            { .3f, .5f, .9f });
        appendFace(polyhedron, GLFace::Rect,
            { { x, -y, z }, { x, -y, -z }, { x, y, -z }, { x, y, z } },
            { .9f, .8f, .3f });
        appendFace(polyhedron, GLFace::Rect,
            { { -x, y, z }, { x, y, z }, { x, y, -z }, { -x, y, -z } },
            { .3f, .8f, .9f });
        appendFace(polyhedron, GLFace::Rect,
            { { -x, -y, -z }, { x, -y, -z }, { x, -y, z }, { -x, -y, z } },
            { .8f, .3f, .9f });
    } else if (shape == GLShape::Pyramid) {
        const float x = sideLengths.x * 0.5f;
        const float y = sideLengths.y * 0.5f;
        const float z = sideLengths.z * 0.5f;
        const glm::vec3 frontLeft{ -x, -y, z };
        const glm::vec3 frontRight{ x, -y, z };
        const glm::vec3 backRight{ x, -y, -z };
        const glm::vec3 backLeft{ -x, -y, -z };
        const glm::vec3 apex{ 0.0f, y, 0.0f };
        polyhedron.faces.reserve(5);
        // 앞, 오른쪽, 뒤, 왼쪽, 바닥. 삼각형과 사각형은 바깥쪽 winding이다.
        appendFace(polyhedron, GLFace::Triangle,
            { frontLeft, frontRight, apex }, { .9f, .3f, .3f });
        appendFace(polyhedron, GLFace::Triangle,
            { frontRight, backRight, apex }, { .3f, .5f, .9f });
        appendFace(polyhedron, GLFace::Triangle,
            { backRight, backLeft, apex }, { .3f, .8f, .4f });
        appendFace(polyhedron, GLFace::Triangle,
            { backLeft, frontLeft, apex }, { .9f, .8f, .3f });
        appendFace(polyhedron, GLFace::Rect,
            { backLeft, backRight, frontRight, frontLeft }, { .8f, .3f, .9f });
    } else if (shape == GLShape::Tetra) {
        // 원점에서 직교하는 세 모서리를 만들고, 무게중심을 로컬 원점으로 옮긴다.
        const glm::vec3 center = sideLengths * 0.25f;
        const glm::vec3 origin = -center;
        const glm::vec3 x = glm::vec3(sideLengths.x, 0.0f, 0.0f) - center;
        const glm::vec3 y = glm::vec3(0.0f, sideLengths.y, 0.0f) - center;
        const glm::vec3 z = glm::vec3(0.0f, 0.0f, sideLengths.z) - center;
        polyhedron.faces.reserve(4);
        appendFace(polyhedron, GLFace::Triangle,
            { origin, y, x }, { .9f, .4f, .3f });
        appendFace(polyhedron, GLFace::Triangle,
            { origin, x, z }, { .3f, .8f, .4f });
        appendFace(polyhedron, GLFace::Triangle,
            { origin, z, y }, { .3f, .5f, .9f });
        appendFace(polyhedron, GLFace::Triangle,
            { x, y, z }, { .9f, .8f, .3f });
    }
    return polyhedron;
}

inline Model DiagramSystem::makeSphere(float radius,unsigned slices,unsigned stacks) {
    Model model;
    if(!std::isfinite(radius)||radius<=0||slices<3||slices>512||stacks<2||stacks>256)return model;
    Mesh mesh;mesh.localVertices.push_back({0,radius,0});
    constexpr double pi=3.14159265358979323846;
    for(unsigned row=1;row<stacks;++row) {
        const double latitude=pi*row/stacks;
        for(unsigned col=0;col<slices;++col) {
            const double longitude=2*pi*col/slices;
            mesh.localVertices.push_back(radius*glm::vec3(std::sin(latitude)*std::cos(longitude),
                std::cos(latitude),std::sin(latitude)*std::sin(longitude)));
        }
    }
    const auto bottom=std::uint32_t(mesh.localVertices.size());
    mesh.localVertices.push_back({0,-radius,0});
    for(unsigned col=0;col<slices;++col) {
        const auto next=(col+1)%slices;
        mesh.triangleIndices.insert(mesh.triangleIndices.end(),{0,1+next,1+col});
        for(unsigned row=0;row+2<stacks;++row) {
            const auto a=1+row*slices+col,b=1+row*slices+next,c=a+slices,d=b+slices;
            mesh.triangleIndices.insert(mesh.triangleIndices.end(),{a,b,c,b,d,c});
        }
        const auto a=1+(stacks-2)*slices+col,b=1+(stacks-2)*slices+next;
        mesh.triangleIndices.insert(mesh.triangleIndices.end(),{a,b,bottom});
    }
    for(const auto& p:mesh.localVertices)mesh.vertexNormals.push_back(glm::normalize(p));
    model.faces.push_back(std::move(mesh));
    return validPolyhedron(model)?model:Model{};
}
inline Model DiagramSystem::makeCone(float radius,float height,unsigned slices) {
    Model model;
    if(!std::isfinite(radius)||!std::isfinite(height)||radius<=0||height<=0||slices<3||slices>512)return model;
    constexpr double pi=3.14159265358979323846;
    // Separate sides/base keep the bottom rim sharp for normals and outlines.
    Mesh sides,base;sides.localVertices.push_back({0,height*.5f,0});
    base.localVertices.push_back({0,-height*.5f,0});
    for(unsigned i=0;i<slices;++i) {
        const double a=2*pi*i/slices;
        const glm::vec3 p{radius*float(std::cos(a)),-height*.5f,radius*float(std::sin(a))};
        sides.localVertices.push_back(p);base.localVertices.push_back(p);
    }
    for(unsigned i=0;i<slices;++i) {
        const auto a=1+i,b=1+(i+1)%slices;
        sides.triangleIndices.insert(sides.triangleIndices.end(),{0,b,a});
        base.triangleIndices.insert(base.triangleIndices.end(),{0,a,b});
    }
    recalculateNormals(sides);recalculateNormals(base);
    model.faces={std::move(sides),std::move(base)};
    return validPolyhedron(model)?model:Model{};
}

inline glm::mat4 DiagramSystem::modelMatrix(const Transform3D& transform) {
    return detail::transformMatrix(transform);
}

inline glm::mat4 DiagramSystem::faceModelMatrix(const Component_Poly& component,
                                         const PlaneFigure& face) {
    return detail::faceMatrix(component, face);
}

inline bool CameraSystem::validCamera(const Camera& camera) {
    const glm::vec3 direction = camera.target - camera.position;
    const glm::vec3 right = glm::cross(direction, camera.up);
    return finiteVector(camera.position) && finiteVector(camera.target)
        && finiteVector(camera.up) && finiteVector(direction) && finiteVector(right)
        && std::isfinite(glm::dot(direction, direction))
        && std::isfinite(glm::dot(right, right))
        && glm::dot(direction, direction) > 0.000001f
        && glm::dot(right, right) > 0.000001f
        && std::isfinite(camera.fieldOfViewDegrees)
        && camera.fieldOfViewDegrees > 0.0f && camera.fieldOfViewDegrees < 180.0f
        && std::isfinite(camera.nearPlane) && std::isfinite(camera.farPlane)
        && camera.nearPlane > 0.0f && camera.farPlane > camera.nearPlane
        && std::isfinite(camera.orthographicHalfExtent)
        && camera.orthographicHalfExtent > 0.0f;
}

inline glm::mat4 CameraSystem::viewMatrix(const Camera& camera) {
    return glm::lookAt(camera.position, camera.target, camera.up);
}

inline glm::mat4 CameraSystem::projectionMatrix(const Camera& camera, float aspect) {
    if (camera.orthographic) {
        const float halfWidth = camera.orthographicHalfExtent * (aspect >= 1.0f ? aspect : 1.0f);
        const float halfHeight = camera.orthographicHalfExtent / (aspect < 1.0f ? aspect : 1.0f);
        return glm::ortho(-halfWidth, halfWidth, -halfHeight, halfHeight,
                          camera.nearPlane, camera.farPlane);
    }

inline void Scene::rebuildFaceIds() {

    for (EntityId id : polyId_) {

        auto* ids = model.shape == GLShape::Cube ? &cubeFaceId_
            : model.shape == GLShape::Tetra ? &tetraFaceId_
            : model.shape == GLShape::Pyramid ? &pyramidFaceId_ : nullptr;

inline std::optional<EntityId> Scene::addModel(const Model& model, const Transform3D& transform,
                                             PivotMode pivot, const glm::vec3& customPivot) {
    if(!DiagramSystem::validPolyhedron(model) || !detail::finiteVector(customPivot)) return {};
    auto initial=transform;
    if(pivot==PivotMode::BottomCenter) initial.localBasis=detail::bottomCenter(model);
    else if(pivot==PivotMode::Custom) initial.localBasis=customPivot;

inline bool Scene::setModel(EntityId id, const Model& model) {
    if(id>=components_.size() || !DiagramSystem::validPolyhedron(model)) return false;

    auto replacement=components_[id];
    replacement.polyhedron=model;replacement.sideLengths=box.second-box.first;replacement.transformOnly=false;
    if(replacement.pivotMode==PivotMode::BottomCenter)
        replacement.transform.localBasis=detail::bottomCenter(model);
    components_[id]=std::move(replacement);
    rebuildFaceIds();geometryRevision_=nextGeometryRevision();return true;
}
```

```text
inline std::uint64_t nextGeometryRevision() {
    // 장면 복사·교체 시에도 다른 형상에 같은 revision을 부여하지 않는다.

inline void appendFace(Polyhedron& polyhedron, GLFace shape,
                std::initializer_list<glm::vec3> vertices, GlColor color) {
    PlaneFigure face;
    face.shape = shape;
    face.localVertices = vertices;
    face.color = color;
    face.normal = glm::normalize(glm::cross(
        face.localVertices[1] - face.localVertices[0],
        face.localVertices[2] - face.localVertices[0]));
    polyhedron.faces.push_back(face);
}

inline std::optional<EntityId> Scene::push_entity(
    const Polyhedron& polyhedron, const Transform3D& transform
) {
    if (!DiagramSystem::validPolyhedron(polyhedron)
        || !DiagramSystem::validTransform(transform)) {
        return (Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Scene, "Scene::push_entity", "Rejected condition: !DiagramSystem::validPolyhedron(polyhedron) || !DiagramSystem::validTransform(transform)", "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships."), std::nullopt);
    }
    glm::vec3 minimum = polyhedron.faces[0].localVertices[0];
    glm::vec3 maximum = minimum;
    for (const PlaneFigure& face : polyhedron.faces) {
        for (const glm::vec3& vertex : face.localVertices) {
            minimum = glm::min(minimum, vertex);
            maximum = glm::max(maximum, vertex);
        }
    }
    if (!finiteVector(maximum - minimum)) return (Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__,__LINE__,PipelineStage::Scene, "Scene::push_entity", "Rejected condition: !finiteVector(maximum - minimum)", "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships."), std::nullopt);
    const EntityId id = components_.size();
    components_.push_back({ polyhedron, transform, maximum - minimum });
    polyId_.push_back(id);
    std::vector<FaceId>* faceIds = nullptr;
    if (polyhedron.shape == GLShape::Cube) faceIds = &cubeFaceId_;
    if (polyhedron.shape == GLShape::Tetra) faceIds = &tetraFaceId_;
    if (polyhedron.shape == GLShape::Pyramid) faceIds = &pyramidFaceId_;
    if (faceIds) for (std::size_t i = 0; i < polyhedron.faces.size(); ++i)
        faceIds->push_back({id, i});
    geometryRevision_ = nextGeometryRevision();
    return id;
}

inline std::optional<glm::mat4> Scene::worldMatrix(EntityId id) const {
```
